_description: Screen9 Public Domain & Geo-Fencing Rights Vault. Tracks movies that are Public Domain globally or in specific countries (e.g. India 60-year rule), plus upcoming classics entering Public Domain soon, so Screen9 can self-host and geo-fence them behind a paywall without re-researching.

public_domain_now.title: Awaara
public_domain_now.license_note: Indian Copyright Act Section 26 (60 years from calendar year after publication). Restored in US under URAA (95-year term).
underlying_rights_warnings: Avoid using modern studio 4K remasters (new restoration copyright); use original/vintage prints if self-hosting.
Standalone music/lyrics publishing rights may have separate terms from the film recording.

public_domain_now.title: Shree 420
public_domain_now.license_note: Public Domain in India since Jan 1, 2016 (60-year film term). Protected in US until Dec 31, 2050 under URAA.
underlying_rights_warnings: Avoid modern studio restorations if self-hosting; use vintage prints.
Check standalone music composition/lyrics rights if extracting songs separately.

public_domain_now.title: Pyaasa
public_domain_now.license_note: Public Domain in India since Jan 1, 2018 (60-year film term). Protected in US until Dec 31, 2052 under URAA.
underlying_rights_warnings: Do NOT download Ultra's 4K restored Blu-ray/YouTube master for self-hosting (restoration copyright).
Will need an English .vtt/.srt subtitle track if self-hosted later.

public_domain_now.title: Kaagaz Ke Phool
public_domain_now.license_note: Public Domain in India since Jan 1, 2020 (60-year film term). Protected in US until Dec 31, 2054 under URAA.
underlying_rights_warnings: Do NOT use Ultra's 4K restored master for self-hosting; use an original/vintage print.
Will need an English .vtt/.srt subtitle track if self-hosted later.

public_domain_now.title: Guide
public_domain_now.license_note: Entered Public Domain in India on Jan 1, 2026 (60-year film term). Protected in US until Dec 31, 2060 under URAA.
underlying_rights_warnings: Adapted from R.K. Narayan's novel 'The Guide' (author passed away in 2001 — literary copyright in India lasts until 2062; verify underlying-work clearance before paywall self-hosting).
Do NOT use Ultra's 4K restoration for self-hosting; use original print.
